reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must refuse a USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION/ERROR PROCEDURE statement (on a report file-name, OUTPUT or EXTEND) that is not the first sentence after a declarative section header or that shares its sentence with another statement, and must refuse anything in the rest of that section other than named procedural paragraphs (by §1985:IV.6.4.1.2 a section is a header followed by paragraphs, so an unnamed sentence after the USE sentence is not one).

edition-consulted.switches: Constructs.ProcedureWithoutLeadingParagraph2002 (2002 Annex F.2 item 90): a sentence after the USE sentence and before the first paragraph-name is refused below 2002 (COBOL0900) and accepted at 2002 and later

reader.edition-search: DeclCollectSection (first sentence = exactly one USE, COBOL0897) and the USE arm of BindStatementCore (any USE reaching the binder is misplaced, COBOL2377) read no edition; the only edition consultation on the path is the F.2 item 90 gate in VersionConformancePass.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: an unnamed sentence after the USE sentence (u7) is refused at 85 by COBOL0900 and compiles at --std 2023, which F.2 item 90 relaxed; the placement and sentence-by-itself halves are the same code at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb361 covers only a USE in a nondeclarative paragraph; a USE after a paragraph-name or a statement in a declarative section, a USE sharing its sentence, a second USE in the section, the unnamed-sentence remainder and the legal OUTPUT/EXTEND/file-name forms are not exercised

reader.notes: Every half of SR1 is refused at 85; the remainder half (an unnamed sentence after USE) rests on the 85-only F.2 item 90 gate, which is the arm this edition needs. COBOL2377 on u3 says 'in the nondeclarative portion' for a USE written under a declarative paragraph-name, and every message cites only §2023 at 85 (wording blemishes; the programs are refused).

refuter.evidence: Probes: r10 (two USE statements in one sentence after the section header) -> COBOL0897 first sentence shall be a single USE; r14 (USE ON OUTPUT, paragraph D-P, then paragraph D-Q holding a USE ON EXTEND) -> COBOL2377 'inside a declarative section, after its first sentence'; r11 (1985 segmented declarative header D-ERR SECTION 10. then USE ON PRT, a paragraph, and a second section with USE ON EXTEND and zero paragraphs) -> compiles and runs, DONE, exit 0. A first attempt with SECTION 50 was refused COBOL6819 by §1985:XVI.3.2.3 SR3 (declarative segment numbers < 50), which is right. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.4.8.3 SR1 'must appear in a sentence by itself'.
